changes.text: 田文死后，公叔为相，娶魏公主，想加害吴起。公叔的仆人说了一句很轻的话：「起易去也。」计策分两步。第一步是进言：吴起是贤人，而魏国小，又与强秦接壤，恐怕他没有长留之心；不妨以公主的婚事试探他——「起有留心則必受之。無留心則必辭矣。以此卜之。」第二步是安排：召吴起一同回家，令公主发怒、当面轻慢魏相。

After Tian Wen died, Gongshu became chancellor; he had married a Wei princess, and he sought to harm Wu Qi. His servant said something very light — in translation, that Wu Qi was easy to remove. The scheme ran in two steps. First, a word to the marquis: Wu Qi is a man of talent, but Wei is a small state and borders mighty Qin; I fear he has no thought of staying. Test him with the offer of a princess — in the servant's words, rendered here in translation: if Wu Qi means to stay, he will certainly accept; if he has no such intention, he will certainly decline; use this to gauge him. Second, the arrangement: invite Wu Qi home with the chancellor, and have the princess lose her temper and slight the chancellor in front of him.
吴起看见公主轻贱魏相，果然辞掉了这门婚事。武侯因此疑心他，不再相信他。吴起怕获罪，就离开魏国，去了楚国。

Wu Qi saw the princess slighting the chancellor of Wei, and sure enough he declined the match. Marquis Wu drew suspicion from this and no longer believed him. Wu Qi, afraid of the consequences, left Wei and went on to Chu.

dispositions.rationale: 段末“吴起自知不如田文”出自 E17，现已把 SJ0651-E17 加入 sections.story.4 的证据列表。正文不变。
证据只写“公叔”，不支持“Lord Shu”这一释义，因此删去英文中的“(Lord Shu)”，只保留 Gongshu。中文原本无此注，按同步规则一并给出未改动的中文全文。

evidence.quote: 田文既死，公叔為相，尚魏公主，而害吳起。

dispositions.rationale: 删除中文正文末尾残留的证据编号“（SJ0651-E20）”。证据编号只应放在 ev 里。英文原本无此标记，按同步规则一并给出未改动的英文全文。

evidence.quote: 吳起懼得罪，遂去，即之楚。

dispositions.rationale: analysis.2 中文所引「在德不在險」逐字出自 E10，但该段原先只引 E25。现把 SJ0651-E10 加入该段证据列表，使引语有对应出处。正文不变。

evidence.quote: 吳起說武侯以形勢不如德，然行之於楚，以刻暴少恩亡其軀。
